name: kalshi-weather-logistic-forward-20261103
purpose: Untouched forward test of the forecast-augmented logistic weather model against the Kalshi market price on event dates whose outcomes did not exist when this plan was recorded. Paper only: no orders, no funds.

model.description: The existing L2 logistic model (C=1) with forecast augmentation, fitted once on the report's training rows and never refitted.

inputs: Each contract's archived order-book top (best bid and best ask) received in the campaign's frozen capture window, 16:00-16:15 America/New_York (21:00-21:15 UTC for every declared date) on the day before the event date, and the Open-Meteo gfs_global run initialized 12:00 UTC on the day before the event date, whose event-day maximum becomes a bracket probability with a 3.0 F spread. raw_market is the bid-ask midpoint.
contract_set: Every contract the campaign's 12 UTC capture priced for a declared event date and series (an active unresolved contract with a supported strike and both book sides visible), whose settlement snapshot resolves it binary with unchanged rules. A series snapshot holding any pending contract contributes no contract, as in the campaign evaluator.
scoring_rule: For each scored event date, the date's paired Brier difference is the model's mean squared error minus raw_market's mean squared error over that date's eligible contracts, pooled across series. The primary estimate is the unweighted mean of the per-date differences; negative favors the model. Its interval is a Student t interval at the declared confidence with one event date as one unit, and its minimum detectable effect is t_crit(n - 1, alpha) * sd / sqrt(n) over the n scored dates. Trades use the existing quoted taker policy unchanged: one contract per eligible contract, YES at the ask or NO at one minus the bid, quadratic taker fee at the declared coefficient rounded up to a whole cent, taken only when the model's expected value clears the declared hurdle after the fee. Report the trade count, total P&L, P&L with the declared extra cost per trade, and the per-opportunity mean with an event-date-clustered interval.
decision_rule: A forward lead requires all three: the mean per-date paired Brier difference below zero, its interval's upper bound below zero, and positive P&L after the extra cost per trade. Each criterion is reported pass or fail. A lead does not establish an executable edge and does not authorize funded orders.
missing_policy: Every declared date is reported. A date with no eligible contract, or whose captures or settlements are missing, failed, interrupted, pending or not yet due, is listed with each plan's dispositions and contributes nothing; no date outside the declared list is scored, and nothing is substituted or retried.
scope: Hypothetical fills at the archived quote: depth, queue position, latency and the exchange's actual fees are not verified, and no collateral budget is shared across trades.
